name: Sprites
long_description:
Sprites is a proactive agent that achieves growth goals for businesses fully autonomously, starting with performance marketing. 

Today, Sprites manages $30M of annualized growth spend for 50+ businesses in a self-improving loop. Sprites has grown 5x this quarter with customers including Gameloft, Klarity Health, Hyperice, and leading AI labs.

You give it a goal. It does the work. Every week it gets better at your business.

Teams use it instead of hiring an agency or a growth team.
